name: database-minus
description: A database cylinder with a minus sign.
useCase: Remove a database from a list or cluster.
misuse: Name the action or status in the surrounding text or the control label.

16.reason: The open lower-right rim leaves clear space for the complete action mark, while the upper ellipse and two lower layers identify the database.

24.reason: The complete action mark remains separate from the database layers, with shared margins around the full square drawing frame.
